capabilities: set up a CODE, PARA, and Zettelkasten workspace with preview before installing files
create fleeting, reference, book, project, and permanent notes via a note creator command
provide bilingual folder and concept guides plus a welcome guide and optional templates
skip existing files and add missing ones on repeated setup without overwriting edits
disambiguation: It scaffolds folders, guides, and templates for knowledge management methods; it does not organize or process your existing notes.
extras: Mobile has not been tested on a device; requires Obsidian 1.14.4 or later. Works offline with no network requests or telemetry, and its community listing review status is still pending.
problem: Obsidian gives no ready-made structure for following knowledge management methods, so users have to build folders, guides, and templates themselves.

relations.evidence: To run the optional TPL - templates yourself, install Templater separately.
The welcome guide also explains how to set up Periodic Notes for journals.

summary: Workspace scaffolding plugin that sets up a CODE, PARA, and Zettelkasten folder structure with guides, templates, and a note creator in English or Korean.
